task.title: Baho va olimpiadaga ruxsat
task.description: Platforma score (0–100 ball) va age (yosh) ni beradi. let grade e’lon qiling va if / else if / else zanjiri bilan son ko‘rinishidagi baho bering: 90 va yuqori - 5, 75 dan - 4, 60 dan - 3, pastroq - 2. const canEnter - olimpiadaga ruxsat: yosh 14 dan va ball 60 dan. Ternar operator bilan const status: "Ruxsat berildi" yoki "Ruxsat berilmadi". Konsolga shablon satr bilan chiqaring: Baho: 4. Ruxsat berildi. Faqat qat’iy solishtirishlardan foydalaning.

tests.name: 95 ball → 5
tests.fail: Avval eng qat’iy shartni tekshiring: score >= 90.

tests.name: 74 ball → 3
tests.fail: 74 75 dan kichik, lekin 60 dan kichik emas - bu 3.

tests.name: 59 ball → 2
tests.fail: 60 dan past - else tarmog‘i, baho 2 (son, qo‘shtirnoqsiz).

tests.name: 13 yosh va 95 ball - ruxsat berilmadi
tests.fail: IKKALA shart ham kerak: || emas, && operatori.

tests.name: Ruxsat chegaralari: 14 yosh va 60 ball - ruxsat berildi
else if ishlatilgan
tests.fail: Baho tanlashni if / else if / else zanjiri bilan yozing.

tests.name: Dastur xatosiz bajariladi
tests.fail: Kodda xato bor - uning matnini konsolda o‘qing.

hints: let grade; ni if dan oldin e’lon qiling, tarmoqlarda faqat qiymat bering: grade = 5;
Tartib: avval score >= 90, keyin >= 75, keyin >= 60, oxirida else.

questions.question: Kod nimani chiqaradi: const t = 30; if (t > 25) { console.log("Issiq"); } else { console.log("Iliq"); }
questions.explanation: 30 > 25 - true, birinchi tarmoq bajariladi, else o‘tkazib yuboriladi.

questions.question: score = 95. Nima chiqadi: if (score >= 60) { console.log("Qabul"); } else if (score >= 90) { console.log("A’lo"); }
questions.explanation: Birinchi mos tarmoq bajariladi. Qat’iy shartlar birinchi qo‘yiladi.

questions.question: Qaysi operator «VA» ni bildiradi? Uni kiriting.
questions.explanation: a && b faqat ikkalasi rost bo‘lsa true.

questions.question: Qaysi qiymatlar falsy?
questions.explanation: Bo‘sh bo‘lmagan satrlar, hatto "0" va "false" ham - truthy.

questions.question: «hour 6 dan 11 gacha (ular ham kiradi)» qanday to‘g‘ri yoziladi?
questions.explanation: && orqali ikkita solishtirish. 6 <= hour <= 11 doim true beradi.

questions.question: Nima chiqadi: const age = 20; console.log(age >= 18 ? "Katta" : "Bola");
questions.explanation: Shart rost - ikki nuqtadan oldingi qiymat olinadi.

questions.question: if (role = "admin") { ... } da nima bo‘ladi?
options: Qiymat berish: role "admin" bo‘ladi, blok bajariladi

questions.question: switch haqida nima to‘g‘ri?
options: Hech bir case mos kelmasa default bajariladi
questions.explanation: Oraliqlar uchun if / else if kerak.

questions.question: switch da case "dush" dan keyin break tushib qolgan. day = "dush" bo‘lsa nima bo‘ladi?
options: Bajarilish keyingi case da davom etadi

questions.question: if / else if / else zanjirida nechta tarmoq bajariladi? Sonni kiriting.
questions.explanation: Faqat bittasi - birinchi mos keladigani yoki else.

questions.question: Vazifani konstruksiya bilan moslashtiring.
questions.explanation: Har bir konstruksiya o‘z vazifasiga mos.
